```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(openxlsx)
library(knitr)
```

##Pull in compiled data and export annual files
```{r Pull in compiled data files, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}

#write out a csv of all the data to the main folder: 
final_data <- read.csv("../COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_AllData.csv")

##Separate by year for ESS-DIVE 
final_data_2023 <- subset(final_data, Year == "2023")
final_data_2024 <- subset(final_data, Year == "2024")

##Write out annual data files
write.csv(final_data_2023, "Data package/COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_2023.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(final_data_2024, "Data package/COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_2024.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

##Create dd file
```{r make metadata, include = FALSE}

#pull the column names from the all_dat1 dataframe and create a new dataframe with them
dd <- data.frame(Column_Names = colnames(final_data))
dd

dd$Unit <- ""
dd$Definition <- ""
dd$Column_Long_Name <- dd$Column_Names
dd$data_type <- ""
dd$Instrument_ifapplicable <- ""

#add information about each line:
```

##Create flmd file
```{r}

files  = list.files("Data package")
files

files = c("COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_2023.csv", "COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_2024.csv", "dd.csv")

flmd <- data.frame(file_name = files)
flmd

flmd$file_description <- ""
flmd$standard <- ""
flmd$file_version <- ""
flmd$data_orientation <- ""
flmd$header_rows <- ""
flmd$column_or_row_name_position <- ""
flmd$notes <- ""

#add information about each line:

flmd$file_description <-  c("Soil gas well data taken from COMPASS synoptic sites in 2023",
                            "Soil gas well data taken from COMPASS synoptic sites in 2024",
                            "Data dictionary file for COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_2023.csv and COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_2024.csv describing each column in the dataset")

flmd$data_orientation <-  c("horizontal",
                            "horizontal",
                            "horizontal")

flmd$header_rows <-   c("1",
                        "1",
                        "1")

flmd$column_or_row_name_position <- c("1",
                                      "1",
                                      "1")


#write out the flmd associated with the data:
write.csv(flmd, "Data package/flmd.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


## Create site list
```{r create site list}

##Description, Latitude, Longitude

MSM <- data.frame(
  Description = "Moneystump Swamp (MSM); one of the COMPASS-FME synoptic sites located in the Blackwater National Wildlife Refuge along the mesohaline Beaverdam Creek. This synoptic site consists of three plots: upland ('UP'; located at 38.4315N, 76.2267W), transition ('TR'; 38.4310N, 76.2277W), and wetland ('W'; 38.4308N, 76.2286W). The site was established in June 2022. The transect spans a coastal loblolly pine forest and a mesohaline marsh dominated by Spartina and Distichlis.", 
  Latitude = "38.4310 degrees", 
  Longitude = "-76.2277 degrees")

SWH <- data.frame(
  Description = "Sweet Hall Marsh (SWH); one of the COMPASS-FME synoptic sites located along the tidal fresh Pamunkey River, one of the two tributaries of the York River in Virginia, USA. The COMPASS-FME consists of three plots: upland ('UP'; located at 37.5708N, 76.8954W), swamp ('SWAMP'; located at 37.57069N, 76.8957W), transition ('TR'; 37.56883N, 76.8964W), and wetland ('W'; 37.56659N, 76.8970W). The synoptic site was established in June 2023. This site is also identified as a Chesapeake Bay National Research Reserve site.", 
  Latitude = "37.56883 degrees", 
  Longitude = "-76.8964 degrees")

GCW <- data.frame(
  Description = "GCReW (GCW); one of the COMPASS-FME synoptic sites, and has three plots: upland ('UP'; located at 38.8741N, 76.5522W), transition ('TR'; 38.8745, 76.5515W), and wetland ('W'; 38.8750N, 76.5500W). Note that this site overlaps spatially with the TEMPEST (TMP) plots, the upland portion of the transect overlaps with the TEMPEST experiment control plot. This transect spans a mid- to late-successional (~80 years old) temperate, deciduous coastal forest and a mesohaline marsh along the Rhode River in Edgewater, MD.",
  Latitude = "38.8745 degrees", 
  Longitude = "-76.5515 degrees")

GWI <- data.frame(
  Description = "Goodwin Islands (GWI); one of the COMPASS-FME synoptic sites, located along the polyhaline York River, and has three plots: upland ('UP'; located at 37.2192N, 76.4087W), transition ('TR'; 37.2194N, 76.4092W), and wetland ('W'; 37.2189N, 76.4101W). The site was established in June 2022.", 
  Latitude = "37.2194 degrees", 
  Longitude = "-76.4092 degrees")

site_list = bind_rows(MSM, SWH, GCW, GWI)

#write out the site list associated with the data:
write.csv(site_list, "Data package/site_list.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
